pilot.title: Tuesday at 10:14
pilot.caption: Time runs down the page. Worker B marks the loan paid and deletes its message, then a deploy restarts it before it calls the bank. The books say paid; the bank never hears about loan 4471.

two-levels.title: Nine steps, one Pay
two-levels.caption: Nine steps of the design, one step of PayOnce. Every design state on the left translates to a PayOnce state on the right; only Confirm(A) changes it.

implication.title: Every translated behavior lands inside
implication.caption: Spec ⇒ Abstract!Spec: every behavior of the design, translated through the mapping, lands inside the behaviors PayOnce allows. A behavior outside it is a refinement failure.

mapping-choices.title: Three mappings, one happy behavior
mapping-choices.caption: The same five states, three translations. Only “the bank” puts the status change and the money in the same step, so only it turns Confirm(A) into a Pay.

stutter.title: The work happens inside a stutter
stutter.caption: The self-loop is where the design does its work. Receive, Expire, Send and Crash change the design but leave PayOnce’s two variables alone, so PayOnce sees a stutter.

failure-step.title: Paid, 1 becomes paid, 2
failure-step.caption: A safety failure of refinement: the PayOnce column reads like a real PayOnce behavior until the last step, which PayOnce forbids.

liveness-carried.title: Pay enabled, never taken
liveness-carried.caption: Every step of the pilot is a stutter of PayOnce, yet the behavior breaks PayOnce’s weak fairness. Drop the fairness (RefinesSafety) and both broken designs pass.
